item.title: RimWorld QoL MODs Every Colony Needs (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Quality-of-life (QoL) MODs make RimWorld easier to manage without changing the core game. Here are the best QoL MODs for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Essential QoL MODs MODWhat it improves Allow ToolMass haul / forbid commands, faster stockpile control. RimHUDAll colonist stats on one screen. Designator ShapesEasier room and wall drawing. Better Workbench ManagementSmarter bill automation. NumbersAt-a-glance colony-wide statistics. Why QoL MODs Matter RimWorld's default UI is minimal. QoL MODs cut the micromanagement time dramatically, letting you focus on the colony story instead of clicking every haul order.
